about: Starting preset for a mine, quarry or industrial yard. Data only: code never names a place type. new-settings copies the allowed_off entries that fit into the settings as "off" entries.

allowed_off.reason: underground or under cover: no sun fade
bare spoil and rock: nothing takes root
inside the buildings: dry, nothing grows (a flagstone floor, floor.stone, may be a patio or a step outdoors, so it is not switched off)

footfall_shapes.note: a track along the rails or the yard route

notes: coal dust, rails, rust, ruts in mud
source: the plugin 1.4.0 design: a first try, judge by looking
